figurative_meaning_en: Those who eat together (referring to a joint family)
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমাদের পরিবার একান্ন, সবাই একসাথে খাই।
example_sentences_in_english: Our family is একান্ন; we all eat together.
In the village, the joint family system of eating together is still prevalent.
history: Originates from the traditional Bengali joint family system where multiple generations share meals to symbolize unity.
note: Often used to describe harmonious family living in Bengali culture.
